description: Defines the data structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling 'liValue' types in the lighttpd project, including creation, copying, clearing, and type inspection functions, as well as inline helper functions for list operations.

classes.name: liValue
classes.description: Structure representing a generic value with various types (none, boolean, number, string, list, action, condition).

methods.name: li_value_new_none
methods.description: Creates a new liValue of type NONE.

methods.name: li_value_new_bool
methods.description: Creates a new liValue of boolean type.

methods.name: li_value_new_number
methods.description: Creates a new liValue of number type.

methods.name: li_value_new_string
methods.description: Creates a new liValue of string type.

methods.name: li_value_new_list
methods.description: Creates a new liValue of list type.

methods.name: li_value_new_action
methods.description: Creates a new liValue representing an action (conditional on _LIGHTTPD_BASE_H_).

methods.name: li_value_new_condition
methods.description: Creates a new liValue representing a condition (conditional on _LIGHTTPD_BASE_H_).

methods.name: li_value_new_hashtable
methods.description: Creates a new hash table of string to liValue.

methods.name: li_value_list_append
methods.description: Appends an item to a list-type liValue.

methods.name: li_value_wrap_in_list
methods.description: Wraps the current content in a list with one entry.

methods.name: li_value_copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a liValue.

methods.name: li_value_clear
methods.description: Frees content of a liValue and sets its type to NONE.

methods.name: li_value_free
methods.description: Frees a liValue.

methods.name: li_value_move
methods.description: Moves the content of one liValue to another.

methods.name: li_value_type_string
methods.description: Returns string representation of a liValueType.

methods.name: li_value_to_string
methods.description: Converts a liValue to its string representation.

methods.name: li_value_list_free
methods.description: Frees a list of liValues.

methods.name: li_value_extract_ptr
methods.description: Extracts a pointer from a liValue, setting its type to NONE.

methods.name: li_value_extract_string
methods.description: Extracts a string pointer from a liValue.

methods.name: li_value_extract_list
methods.description: Extracts a list of liValues from a liValue.

methods.name: li_value_extract_action
methods.description: Extracts an action from a liValue (conditional on _LIGHTTPD_BASE_H_).

methods.name: li_value_extract_condition
methods.description: Extracts a condition from a liValue (conditional on _LIGHTTPD_BASE_H_).

methods.name: li_value_extract
methods.description: Moves the value content to a new liValue, setting the old to NONE.

methods.name: li_value_to_key_value_list
methods.description: Converts a value to a list of key-value pairs with string keys.

methods.name: li_value_get_single_argument
methods.description: Returns the single argument if list length is 1, otherwise returns the value itself.

methods.name: li_value_is_nothing
methods.description: Checks if the value is null, NONE, or an empty list.

methods.name: li_value_type
methods.description: Returns the type of a liValue.

methods.name: li_value_list_has_len
methods.description: Checks if a list has a specific length.

methods.name: li_value_list_len
methods.description: Returns the length of a list.

methods.name: li_value_list_at
methods.description: Returns the list element at a specific index.

methods.name: li_value_list_type_at
methods.description: Returns the type of the list element at a specific index.

methods.name: li_value_list_set
methods.description: Sets a list element at a specific index.
